paragraphs.text: Agnes Image 2.5 Flash image generation and editing for DeepSeek Harness
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds one host tool, `agnes_image`, for image generation and image edi
It is deliberately dependency-free: it imports only Node builtins and uses the injected Cordis conte
xt (`ctx.tools`, `ctx.credentials`, `ctx.attachments`, `ctx.workingDirectory`). There is no build st
ep and no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer dependency, so a git install works without any `allowBuilds` approva
and no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer dependency, so a git install works without any `allowBuilds` approval.
The plugin needs an Agnes API key. It looks up the credential reference `AGNES_API_KEY` at runtime (
first `process.env`, then the profile's credential store). Configure **your own** key, for example:
or add it to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`. No key is stored in this repository.
`agnes_image` calls the Agnes images endpoint, saves the result into the Session working directory (
default `agnes-images/`), registers it as an attachment so the image shows inline in the conversatio
n, and returns the durable file path.
Local reference images (png / jpg / jpeg / webp / gif) can be passed for editing and multi-image com
erence images (png / jpg / jpeg / webp / gif) can be passed for editing and multi-image composition.
